_goals_readme: GOALS (20 Oct 2026): what a stat is worth comes from dist/specials_stats.json -> goals (built from the game files), e.g. 1 Endurance = 5 HP, 1 Strength = 5 lb, 1 Agility = 10 AP, 1 Intelligence = 3% XP, Heal Rate = % of max HP per sec (out of combat).

An answer (or build) can list 'goals': { goal: weight }. Each slot in that goal gets weight x (its conversion x its slot ref) / refs[goal] - so a +3 END food (15 HP) is weighed against a +40 Max Health food in the same HP.
refs = how big one 'full-strength' buff is in the goal's own unit. Weight 0 = no weighting, just show the reason on the cards (e.g. VATS: '+2 Perception (+0.8 % hit chance)').
'fallback_add' = hand-set weights used only if specials_stats.json can't load on the page (answers AND builds).

Melee build = melee goal (1 STR = 5% melee damage, fAVDMeleeDamageMult). Unarmed build = unarmed goal (1 STR = 10% unarmed damage, fDamageStrengthMult; Unarmed AND Melee Damage buffs both count) - Kat, 20 Oct 2026.
rules._exclude_items_readme: Item names never recommended (quest-only / can't normally get). Nuclear Don's Custom Chem Blend = W05_MQR_203P Wastelanders main quest chem (+100% dmg, +100 DR, +100 HP) - Claude 20 Oct 2026, ask Kat before adding more.
rules._display_order_readme: Order the result cards and the stat list are shown in: SPECIAL first, then AP Regen, XP and the rest. Reorder freely.
rules._base_weights_readme: Weights every build gets (20 Oct 2026, Kat: bubblegum for hunger & thirst).
rules._when_readme: Magazine / bobblehead buffs whose game text names a condition (fx.w): team = only with 'In a team', sneak = only for sneaky players, night / alcohol = counted at when_share, swim = never counted (still shown).
rules._mirror_readme: Weapon-type crit damage (magazines) is only worth what crit damage is worth to this build: final weight = its own weight (how well it fits the weapon, 0-1) x the build's crit_dmg weight. So VATS builds value them, free aim halves them like crit_dmg.

damage_type.label: What damage does your weapon do?

vats.label: VATS
vats.note: VATS builds live on crits, so Critical Damage is weighted heavily (Overdrive over Psycho for the chem slot).

weapon.label: Main weapon (optional)
weapon.help: Some magazines only boost one weapon type. Picking one puts its magazine first and drops boosts for other damage types.

power.label: Power Armour
power.note: Power Armour already gives big DR / ER and rad resistance, so those buffs drop down the list.

none.label: No armour (Berserker's / Unyielding)
none.note: Berserker's does more damage the LOWER your Damage Resistance is, so anything that adds DR (Psycho, Fury, Lead Champagne, DR food) is left out.

bloodied.label: Bloodied (low health)
bloodied.note: Bloodied builds still want Max Health and Endurance buffs so they can take more hits (Kat, 20 Oct 2026: bloodied always gets Endurance). Rads are fine (they keep your health low), so rad resistance is left out.

ghoul.label: Ghoul
ghoul.note: Ghouls don't need rad resistance and rads don't hurt them. Chems that also refill your Feral meter get a small bonus.

carry.label: Do you struggle with carry weight?

yes.label: Yes
yes.note: You die a lot, so anything that adds HP to your health bar (Max Health, Endurance) and health regen moves up the list (Kat, 20 Oct 2026). Bloodied still keeps regen low - it would heal them out of bloodied.

yes.label: Yes
yes.note: XP hungry: XP buffs, Intelligence (it raises XP gained) and Charisma buffs. Charisma raises your XP through the Inspirational perk card while you're on a team (+20% at 15 CHA, +25% at 30) and your teammates' XP too.

enemy.label: Fighting anything in particular?
enemy.help: For events and farming runs: some magazines only work on one enemy type. Picking one puts those magazines first.

rules._damage_first_readme: Chems and alcohol only get ONE slot each (dispel groups), so that slot goes to DAMAGE OUTPUT: buffs in the 'Damage' slot group count in full, everything else counts at non_damage_share. Carry Weight also counts in full when they say they struggle with carry weight (that is the only time Rad Ant Lager wins).

fishSeasons.rule: Each seasonal fish is catchable for its whole season. The season rotates on the first Tuesday on or after the North American equinox/solstice, at 16:00 UTC.
